title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.80 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases). FrancoisKwk (highball-db#1236, 2026-11-15), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 61 minutes: played for an hour in a closed dungeon only, so whether the open world works isn't known yet, in the player's words.
notes: DXMT's changelog lists its crash on launch as fixed, cloud rendering issues may remain. Reported perfect on a base M1 with DXMT on the default engine (r28) over 61 minutes, in a closed dungeon only, so the open world isn't covered yet (highball-db#1236).
